actions.name: Life Drain
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken.

actions.name: Ethereal Jaunt
actions.description: As a bonus action, the wraith can move up to its speed and pass through walls and other barriers as if moving through difficult terrain.

legendary_actions.name: Ethereal Step
legendary_actions.description: The wraith moves up to half its flying speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Spectral Drain (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The wraith makes one Life Drain attack.
